name: muntin-menu-pricing-study
title: Muntin Menu-Pricing Field Report — evidence table & per-ingredient instrument
description: Two CC BY 4.0 tables behind the menu-pricing field report (/cost-index/menu-pricing/study/): study.csv is the evidence table (the paper's claims × the sources that ground them, each with Muntin's compiled finding/grounds/myth summary + DOI); menu-pricing.csv is the per-ingredient instrument (posture, band, trim tax, cheapest month, co-mover). Descriptive of a tracked record and the published literature — never a forecast, never a measured cause. The per-ingredient numbers are Muntin's own read of US-government public-domain wholesale references; the summaries are Muntin's compiled analysis.

resources.name: menu-pricing
resources.title: Per-ingredient pricing instrument

fields.name: slug
fields.description: Ingredient slug — stable key.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Yield-reference category grouping.

fields.name: posture
fields.description: Pricing posture read against the ingredient's own baseline window.

fields.name: band_pct
fields.description: Half-width of the wholesale-reference band around the ingredient's own baseline — a market-direction spread, never a delivered $/lb.

fields.name: withhold_reason
fields.description: Why a withhold: no_series (no public wholesale series to read) or too_volatile (series too wide to anchor). Blank unless posture=withhold.

fields.name: coverage_pct
fields.description: Share of the baseline window with usable wholesale coverage.

fields.name: edible_yield_pct
fields.description: Edible yield from the 134-ingredient reference — a reference figure, not a measured yield.

fields.name: trim_tax
fields.description: Per-ingredient reciprocal of the edible-yield reference ratio (1 ÷ yield); a reference multiplier, not a delivered cost; computed per row, independent of the category trim multiplier.

fields.name: cheapest_month
fields.description: Month index 1–12, seasonal low in the tracked record; blank where the dispersion noise gate did not clear.

fields.name: save_pct
fields.description: Saving in the cheapest month vs the ingredient's own high; blank where no window cleared.

fields.name: comover
fields.description: A checked co-moving ingredient in the tracked record; blank where none — co-occurrence, never a measured cause.

fields.name: comover_shared
fields.description: Number of shared large-move episodes with the co-mover.

fields.name: comover_of
fields.description: Total large-move episodes considered for the co-mover test.

resources.description: CC BY 4.0 joins computed over US-government public-domain source series (NASS/Census/EIA/PPI); the upstream series are public domain (CC0-equivalent), redistributed with retrieval dates. A wholesale reference, never a delivered price.
